scope: Frozen production bundle in Chromium/Metal. Preset establishes accepted crossing precondition. A model-informed automated player uses ordinary arrow/Enter inputs to play both phases; actual reload and Continue tests phase/resource restoration. No game or shader substitutions. This proves integration, not human difficulty or native-platform acceptance.

phase two reload preserves spent resources and turn

reload preserves the actual crossing position
ordinary command input completes both phases and begins the carry
both live phase definitions were played
fight wins reach the playable extraction
normal movement completion wires every physical breakdown mark
